name: Divoom Pixoo 64
description: Show your FiestaBoard pages on a Divoom Pixoo 64 LED matrix over your local network.
author: FiestaBoard Team

host.title: Device address
host.description: The Pixoo 64's IP address or hostname on your network (for example 192.168.1.50). Find it in the Divoom app under Device Settings.

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.description: Screen brightness from 0 to 100. Leave empty to keep the device's own setting.
